correctness.rationale: The proof gives exhaustive group-order cases: every co-singleton in a group of order at least four other than V4 is an interior product (two explicit constructions); C3 and V4 have no nonsingleton factorization to a co-singleton. Singleton translation equivariance makes all co-singleton-supported automorphisms central shifts, realized exactly in the two exceptions. Unit recognition, finite-subgroup idempotents, left stabilizers and cosets determine the full groups S3 and S4. Exact finite multiplication-table checks reproduced VERIFY_OK; they corroborate but are not used as universal proof.

value.rationale: A natural distinction in current power-semigroup rigidity asks whether an automorphism merely preserves all singleton units or is actually induced by a group automorphism. The theorem gives a complete sharp finite-group classification of automorphisms supported on the maximal proper-subset layer, with a nontrivial exceptional boundary exactly C3 and V4, and exact full automorphism groups S3/S4 for these intrinsic first cases. This is a motivated structure result, not merely a finite table, and it explains why the reduced/full distinction is mathematically substantive.
